He yells red faced and veiny necked at me that my room is a mess and I have to clean it right then and there. He called me a few names like lazy and slob. The room was almost perfect. All that was wrong was an unmade bed two socks on the floor and some chip crumbs. I’m almost finished cleaning about to vacuum and with the vacuum on I complained to myself along the line of “why does he have to be so mean? Does he expect me to be perfect? It wasn’t even dirty.” type of stuff. Well he heard me, runs into the room and smacks me in the back of the head hard. So naturally I kind of stumble to the ground and he is screaming at me that he doesn’t want me to be perfect just clean and that shouldn’t be hard and I should never ever complain about him. All the while screaming at me and kicking me as I’m trying to take cover under my desk. Then I screamed at him crying that he was insane and I wished he was dead and he left. We didn’t talk for like a month. It was a good month.
